title: Finite direct images of constructible sheaves
statement:
Let $f:X\to S$ be finite
with $S$ of finite type over $k$, and let $F$ be a
constructible
$\Lambda$-sheaf on $X_{{\mathrm{et}}}$. Then the direct image
$f_*F$ of [def-weil-pbc-direct-image] is constructible on
$S_{{\mathrm{et}}}$ and $R^qf_*F=0$ for every $q>0$.

proof.text: The coefficient hypothesis supplies Finite Lambda. Spec k is Noetherian, and isNoetherian_of_locallyOfFiniteType applied to the quasi-compact locally finite type structure morphism gives IsNoetherian S.

Apply isConstructibleEtaleSheafOfSets_of_module to F. For its underlying abelian sheaf E, apply isConstructibleEtaleSheafOfSets_lowerStar_of_isNoetherian to f and E. Forgetting coefficients commutes definitionally with lowerStar, since all are the same precomposition on the underlying presheaves.

Apply isConstructibleSheaf_of_finite_coefficient_underlying_sets to the module direct image with I = bottom. The quotient is finite by the surjective quotient map from finite Lambda. Membership in bottom gives r = 0, so zero_smul proves the annihilation hypothesis. Convert this module constructibility to the required finite-constant-value predicate using isConstructibleEtaleModuleSheaf_iff.

Use preservesFiniteColimits_lowerStar_of_isFinite directly with coefficients ModuleCat Lambda. For G = lowerStar and K = F[0], the Plus t-structure gives IsZero H^q(K) for q > 0. The composite of mapDerivedCategoryPlusHomologyFunctorIso with homology applied to the inverse of rightDerivedFunctorPlusIsoMapDerivedCategoryPlus identifies G(H^q(K)) with H^q(RG(K)). Map the zero object through G and transport across this isomorphism.
